text:
sam: Heads up — seeing a small but steady surge of 504s from the dedicated inference pool in eu-west1 since 22:10 UTC. Root cause looks like a regression in the memory bump for the prefix cache. I want to push a tiny hotfix (v3.2.1-hotfix.1) that reverts the allocation change and restores the previous cache cap. Requesting expedited canary and approval to roll forward if canary is healthy.
priya: Can you paste the error sample and the image tag you want pinned? we need rollback steps too.
sam: logs:
```
2026-03-23T22:12:05Z inference-0 error: kv_cache_alloc exceeded cap -> oom_reclaim -> request timeout 504
2026-03-23T22:12:07Z inference-2 warn: retry 1 -> upstream closed
```
image: registry.redwood/inference:v3.2.1-hotfix.1
rollback: pin back to v3.2.0 and drain new nodes; steps listed in ops-runbook section "hotfix-rollback" (2-step: drain, redeploy image)
lucas: How many canary hosts do we want? usual is 10%, but given impact maybe 2 nodes in eu-west1 only and shorter observation window? also what's the maintenance/change window — can we do this now?
sam: propose: 2 canaries in eu-west1, 15m observation, then 10m ramp to 50% if no regressions. We'll keep hosted traffic routing with failover to fallback-model (same family) if errors spike. pref window: now (overnight) — low traffic.
eva: release notes: short blurb please, will send internal comms. Also need to confirm there's no customer-facing migration or config change.
sam: release note draft: "Hotfix v3.2.1-hotfix.1: revert memory allocation change in prefix cache to address 504/timeouts under specific traffic patterns in EU. No model or API change."
priya: tagging oncall — @oncall-bot please assign if needed and confirm SLO alert thresholds.
oncall-bot: @sam @priya assigned: oncall@redwood until 2026-03-24T02:00Z — monitoring hooks enabled. Alerts: high-5xx-rate, token-latency-99th.
deploybot: A deploy has been requested by sam: deploy image registry.redwood/inference:v3.2.1-hotfix.1 to eu-west1 canary (2 instances). CI passed: unit+smoke. Provide approvals to proceed with canary.
priya: I approve the canary deploy. :thumbsup:
lucas: +1 from SRE, I've reviewed rollback section and can perform manual rollback if needed.
eva: +1 product. Communication ready if we need to alert customers.
releasebot: Reminder: please add final release note snippet to the changelog page (docs/internal/changelogs) before full rollout.
sam: noted — added changelog entry and linked the runbook. also included quick healthcheck script in the deploy PR.
priya: one ask — leave autoscaler disabled on the canary nodes and set strict max mem to previous value, just to be safe.
sam: done in the image config and k8s patch. command used:
```bash
kubectl patch deploy inference --patch '{"spec": {"template": {"spec": {"containers": [{"name":"inference","resources":{"limits":{"memory":"8Gi"}}}]}}}}' -n eu-west1
```
priya: ok — with my approval and SRE + product thumbs we're good to start canary. @deploybot kick it off and post status.
deploybot: Canary deploy started: registry.redwood/inference:v3.2.1-hotfix.1 -> eu-west1 [2 instances]. Observing 15m. Canary health checks enabled.
(some silence)
deploybot: Canary update @ 22:23 UTC: 2/2 instances ready, healthchecks OK, 5xx rate trending down to baseline.
sam: good sign. continuing observation
lucas: I'm running the healthcheck probe every 2m and watching p95/p99. no abnormal memory growth seen so far.
priya: at 22:34 UTC, canary looks stable for 15m. I authorize ramp to 50% traffic in eu-west1.
deploybot: Rolling to 50% in eu-west1. Will monitor additional 10m before full
priya: if nothing weird in the next 10m, full rollout approved by me.
deploybot: 10m observation complete. Metric summary: 5xx down 92% from peak, latency stable, no new OOM traces.
sam: proceeding with final rollout to eu-west1. will keep a 10m watch and readiness gates.
lucas: ready to rollback quickly if any spike; I've got monitoring dashboards open.
priya: official +1 final rollout. tagging release notes folks to publish.
eva: publishing internal note now. external customer comms on standby.
deploybot: Full rollout complete for eu-west1. Tags: registry.redwood/inference:v3.2.1-hotfix.1. No incidents reported during watch window.
releasebot: changelog updated; release note published internally.
sam: thanks everyone. follow-up: will open a postmortem ticket to track the allocation change test gap and add a unit+integration test to prevent regression.
priya: thanks — marking this thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
